name: Regulatory decisions
blurb: FDA, DEA, CMS, and state actions: approvals, CRLs, advisory votes, scheduling, REMS, telehealth rules, guidance.

name: Clinical trial outcomes
blurb: Endpoints met or missed, effect sizes, durability, publication or retraction.

name: Company and market outcomes
blurb: Bankruptcies, layoffs, financings, mergers, launches, clinic and telehealth closures, stock and valuation calls with a named threshold.

name: Payer and policy
blurb: Coverage decisions, Medicare and Medicaid, prior authorization, parity, CPT codes, pricing, legislation.

name: Practice adoption
blurb: What becomes or stops being standard care: TMS and accelerated TMS, ketamine, esketamine, ECT, psychedelic therapy, prescribing volumes.
